qualifier: Upstream venue-named competition layouts. Individual YAML files have no event-year or survey-accuracy statement. The upstream README reports FSG 2018 validation of the simulator; that does not certify these coordinates.
edits: Retain original YAML bytes. Convert ordered side labels to CSV: left to blue, right to yellow, orange to orange_small, orange_big to orange_large. This is our current color convention; the upstream legacy SDF uses different cone-model assignments.
Remove only a repeated final vertex equal to the first vertex on a closed side. Do not move, scale, add or respread cone positions.
Write world XY to twelve decimal places in metres. Use the repository's canonical FSAE cone meshes and dimensions.

Convert starting_pose_front_wing to our rear-axle base_link using the canonical car nose offset. Preserve upstream yaw and coordinate axes. With --fit-spawn, align the car at the nearest reference vertex within 5 m that clears the full canonical footprint and cones with 5 cm reserve. Store both requested alignment pose and executed spawn.
Derive a scoring-only closed reference by monotone ordered-boundary alignment, 0.5 m arc sampling and periodic Gaussian smoothing at a 2 m spatial scale. Do not feed it to perception or control.
